build._extra_flags_note: This is the DEFAULT menu configuration from boards.txt: VPR enabled, BLE enabled, Zigbee/Thread/Matter disabled, USB-bridge serial, 64MHz, on-board ceramic antenna. Swap -DNRF54L15_CLEAN_VPR_ENABLED=1 for =0 (and ldscript to nrf54l15_linker_script_no_vpr.ld) to reclaim RAM for non-VPR sketches -- upload.maximum_data_size differs materially between the two (155648 vs 261632 bytes).

upload._upload_note: Confirmed identical to upstream's own boards.txt: upload.target=nrf54l, upload.protocol=cmsis-dap. We bypass their tools/upload.py wrapper (which also handles OpenOCD fallback, UF2 fallback, and a VM-safe no-reset mode via --pyocd-safe) and call pyOCD directly -- confirmed working for erase, not yet confirmed for a real .hex flash+run.

_memory._source: boards.txt upload.maximum_size / upload.maximum_data_size, both VPR menu states
